proof_body:
by
  intro f a b L hab hc hL
  have e : (∫ x in a..b, f x) - (b - a) * f a = ∫ x in a..b, (f x - f a) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hc.intervalIntegrable _ _) (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    simp
  rw [e]
  have hm : (∫ x in a..b, |f x - f a|) ≤ ∫ x in a..b, L * (x - a) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab
    · exact ((hc.sub continuous_const).abs).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · intro x hx
      have h := hL x hx a (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 hab)
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hx.1)] at h
  have hi : (∫ x in a..b, L * (x - a)) = L * (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right (fun x => x) a, integral_id]
    simp
    ring
  calc |∫ x in a..b, (f x - f a)| ≤ ∫ x in a..b, |f x - f a| := intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hab
    _ ≤ ∫ x in a..b, L * (x - a) := hm
    _ = L * (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 := hi
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b L : ℝ), a ≤ b → Continuous f → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x - f y| ≤ L * |x - y|) → |(∫ x in a..b, f x) - (b - a) * f a| ≤ L * (b - a) ^ 2 / 2
